title: Conditional inductive-cylinder recurrence-to-Cauchy interface
question: If an explicit nonnegative local Q3 recurrence and first/double commutator response estimate hold on the bounded inductive-limit cylinder algebra, what exact finite-volume D/delta-D Cauchy coefficient follows at a fixed boundary distance?
method: Use the fixed-support bounded C1 inductive-limit cylinder contract from EXP-001150 as the test-algebra interface.
Assume the explicit nonnegative recurrence L_x(n+1) <= (1+C delta)L_x(n) + J delta sum_{y~x} L_y(n) with z=6, C=J=1, base=2, delta=1/18, N=6 and T=1/3.
Compute the exact weighted step factor 1+(C+J*z*base)*delta, iterate it for six steps, and apply the distance-10 spatial penalty base^(-d) with source mass one.
Multiply the response envelope by the two declared orientations and the full time horizon to obtain the conditional D/delta-D Cauchy coefficient.
Reproduce the arithmetic in an independent Fraction-only lane and compile the exact rational fixtures in Lean R321; keep the actual Q3 recurrence and commutator estimates as explicit open hypotheses.
finding: Primary 14/14, independent 10/10, integrated 19/19, and Lean R321 PASS. decision_reason: The QFT route now has an exact conditional bridge from the bounded inductive-limit cylinder algebra to a finite-volume D/delta-D Cauchy envelope. The bridge is useful because it states the required recurrence and response hypotheses quantitatively, but it does not establish those hypotheses for the actual quartic Q3 dynamics and therefore does not close direct Cauchy, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
